builds.name: Reference: Ranked mid core
builds.goal: Reference for Akali: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ mid players use most (11,892 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 49.6% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A skirmishing assassin who alternates spell hits with ring-crossing empowered attacks and uses shroud to pace an engagement. The current mid provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Hextech Gunblade → Shadowflame → Zhonya's Hourglass. Electrocute keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Sorcerer's Shoes, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff.
builds.summary: The proven mid baseline: Hextech Gunblade → Shadowflame → Zhonya's Hourglass, with Electrocute.
testPlan: Play it in mid as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Hextech Gunblade → Shadowflame → Zhonya's Hourglass) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 49.6% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Hextech Gunblade → Shadowflame → Zhonya's Hourglass.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.

builds.name: Ring Spellblade
builds.summary: Compare damage per completed ring-exit attack.
builds.goal: Compare damage per completed ring-exit attack.
builds.hypothesis: P grants extra attack range and AP magic damage after leaving its ring. Q tip slow and W movement/energy allow a return attack. Lich Bane adds a separate empowered attack, Nashor rewards actual attacks and Cosmic Drive helps ring traversal.
testPlan: Required state: Exit and re-enter the ring with energy for the next spell.
Compare damage per completed ring-exit attack; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Walking the ring loses spell uptime or exposes Akali.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeated casts do not guarantee repeated ready Spellblade procs.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Lich Bane, Nashor's Tooth, Cosmic Drive, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: AP health frontline
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Akali: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A skirmishing assassin who alternates spell hits with ring-crossing empowered attacks and uses shroud to pace an engagement. Can ring-crossing empowered attacks consume Spellblade safely without losing spell or shroud timing? Avoid mana purchases for her energy resource. Health/AP may sustain close spell pressure and debuff targets for allied magic damage.
builds.summary: Health/AP may sustain close spell pressure and debuff targets for allied magic damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Akali: Can ring-crossing empowered attacks consume Spellblade safely without losing spell or shroud timing? Avoid mana purchases for her energy resource.

Start with the early core (Riftmaker or Liandry, then the other) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Energy. Do not treat mana regeneration as Energy recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Health/AP may sustain close spell pressure and debuff targets for allied magic damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Akali throws out five kunai, dealing damage based on her bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power and slowing. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Visage improves healing/shields received by its owner, not every ally shield; no free healing is assumed.
The route fails Akali's stated kit question: Can ring-crossing empowered attacks consume Spellblade safely without losing spell or shroud timing? Avoid mana purchases for her energy resource.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Visage improves healing/shields received by its owner, not every ally shield; no free healing is assumed.
Full cost 15,550 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Riftmaker or Liandry, then the other. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Bloodletter's Curse, Spirit Visage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: Energy. Do not treat mana regeneration as Energy recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.

Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.goal: Measure E2 and R2 success through a pressured shroud.

Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
